listings.remarks: *** Only 3 homes left! *** Don't miss your chance to own a home in First Addition at this price point! Designed for true lock-and-go living, Koval Cottages offers something Lake Oswego has never seen before. Perfect for downsizers, first-time buyers, small families, seasonal residents, or anyone seeking low maintenance luxury in the city’s most charming neighborhood. Each home showcases exceptional finish work, modern contemporary design, and a refined attention to detail throughout. A rare and extraordinary opportunity to own a standalone home in the heart of First Addition. Enjoy effortless access to downtown Lake Oswego’s restaurants, boutique shopping, cafes, and one of the region’s best Saturday Markets!

Vaulted ceilings, a creative loft space, and personality throughout — this home is full of character and ready for your vision. Situated on a large corner lot along a private rd in unincorporated Clackamas County, it offers space, flexibility, and room to make it uniquely your own. A wonderful loft area, which could be used as a second bedroom, adds versatility to the layout, while two fully remodeled bathrooms showcase distinctive design and updated comfort. Unique details and thoughtful touches create a home with warmth and individuality, leaving room for imagination throughout. A pre-home inspection has been completed with many items already addressed, providing added confidence for buyers. Major systems include an updated new roof. Outside, enjoy a long driveway with ample parking and plenty of room for cars, trucks, recreational vehicles, or toys. The property also features an approx. 500 sq. ft. detached studio — ideal for creative space, hobbies, or a private retreat (not included in home square footage). A working hot tub (currently winterized) and spacious yard complete the outdoor setting. A rare opportunity to personalize a home with character, space, and flexibility in a peaceful yet convenient location.

Absolute Charmer within walking distance to Zupans, shops and restaurants of Lake Grove, and quick access to three Oswego Lake easements: Goodin, Springbrook, and Summit Court. Beautiful setting on sought after Upper Drive with peekaboo lake views from the backyard, this private 1940s cottage with Nantucket style shingle siding offers single level living and all the charm of classic Lake Oswego. Oak hardwood floors and parquet entry set a warm tone throughout the main level, where three bedrooms, two baths, and an office are all conveniently on one floor. The office flows into the main living area, anchored by a family room with a warm gas fireplace and wood accent wall, a dining area with a mini wet bar, and a sun filled sitting room with a generous skylight and French doors to the backyard. The open concept kitchen is designed for easy flow and gathering, with a walk in pantry for added storage. The primary suite includes a walk in closet, French doors to the wraparound deck, and a view of the serene water feature. A lower level bonus room with new carpet and fresh paint offers flexible space for a flex/media room, home gym, or guest retreat, alongside a large dry storage area. Gracious grounds with raised beds, a meandering path, and mature backyard gardens complete an outdoor setting made for quiet enjoyment. A freestanding cottage with its own private entrance, lake views, lounge area, and two sliding glass doors to a spacious deck rounds out this exceptional property. Served by Lake Grove Elementary, Lake Oswego Junior High, and Lake Oswego High School, with a detached two car garage completing the package, this is an opportunity to secure one of Lake Oswego's most coveted lakeside addresses.

An opportunity to enjoy a perfect Lake Oswego location. Just minutes to downtown, the Country Club and the Forest Hills lake easement. A warm and inviting retreat with a great family floorplan and expansive outdoor living space on the new deck off the main floor. Two bedrooms on the main and two on the lower floor plus a large family room and office. Attached oversized two car garage and plenty of off street parking. Kitchen has been updated, four fireplaces, lots of skylights bring in tons of natural light. The interior brick wall and open beamed ceilings give this a special English countryside character.

listings.address: 9125 SW GARDEN HOME RD Portland, OR 97223
listings.remarks: Discover a private garden retreat in Portland's desirable Garden Home neighborhood! Set on approximately 0.26 acres in unincorporated Washington County, this single-level home offers backyard privacy, mature landscaping, and convenient access to OHSU, Nike, Intel, and Southwest Portland amenities.The fully fenced backyard features a spacious deck, mature trees and hedges, a stone fire pit, and established apple, pear, plum, fig, and quince trees. Raspberries, a grape arbor, peonies, and a dedicated native garden with an owl box add character. Newer cedar fencing enhances privacy, and a shed provides storage.Inside, hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace with built-in shelving, and separate living and dining areas add warmth. The closable kitchen features a gas range, granite counters, subway tile, and a garden-view window. Two bedrooms, an updated bath, and a generous laundry/utility room complete the layout. An attached single-car garage and driveway accommodating three additional vehicles provide ample parking.Recent upgrades include a 2024 roof with transferable warranty, a 2023 high-efficiency Daikin dual-fuel HVAC system with heat pump, central AC, and gas furnace backup, plus fresh exterior paint and newer cedar fencing. Nearby are Trader Joe's, Fanno Creek Trail, Multnomah Village, Washington Square, and more.

Welcome to Village Cottages, Snug’s latest development located in the heart of Multnomah Village, with all of its shops, restaurants and amenities. Don’t miss your opportunity to own a detached single family home with no condo or HOA - 1 cottage has already sold. The home features 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms and is built with uncompromised quality and true architectural design by Snug, Portland’s premier cottage developer. You must see the home to appreciate all of the designer finishes and upgrades compared to the typical new build. Each home has a TRULY PRIVATE FENCED AND USABLE YARD, so bring your pets and green thumb! The layout lives large with its open concept plan and huge slider leading to a COVERED REAR PATIO for year-round entertaining and grilling. Appreciate the beautiful WOOD BEAMED CEILING and chef's kitchen, which are just a few of the touches that make this home special. Generous sized bedrooms feature huge windows and large closets. It's completely MOVE-IN READY with ALL APPLIANCES including fridge, induction range, dishwasher, built-in microwave, and W/D. There is LOADS OF STORAGE with a large interior pantry. The home is all electric and super efficient with mini-split heating and cooling, heat pump water heater, Energy Star Certified and pre-plumbed for future solar panels that could make the home truly net-zero. Total energy bill estimated at JUST $81 PER MONTH! HES=10. Step inside a Snug home and you'll immediately notice the difference. Live in one, and you'll truly appreciate the details. Builder/ Lender Incentives with our preferred lender are available. This can be used to buydown the rate and help with closing costs. Please reach out for more details.

.62 ACRE LOT! Charming 3 bed 1.5 bath house with many updates throughout. New flooring, stainless appliances, and quartz countertops just to name a few. Quiet neighborhood near parks - easy access to I5. Huge, flat lot with possible development potential. Agent related to seller.

Opportunity awaits in Portland's desirable Skyline area. Situated on over 2 private acres, this expansive 5,197-square-foot residence offers 5 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, a 2-car garage, and four fireplaces in a peaceful wooded setting. Surrounded by mature trees and natural beauty, the property provides a sense of seclusion while remaining just minutes from downtown Portland and everyday conveniences.Inside, the home features a spacious floor plan with multiple living and gathering areas, generously sized bedrooms, and large windows that capture natural light and views of the surrounding landscape. Four fireplaces located throughout the home add warmth, character, and timeless Northwest charm. The versatile layout offers flexibility for a variety of living arrangements, including multigenerational living, home office space, hobby rooms, or extended guest accommodations. The property presents an excellent opportunity for buyers looking to update and personalize a substantial home in a highly sought-after location. With over 5,000 square feet of living space, there is ample room to reimagine and customize the home to fit your needs and style. The sloping acreage creates a private, forested backdrop and contributes to the property's unique Northwest character while offering a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of city life. Homes offering this combination of size, privacy, acreage, and location rarely become available. Bring your vision and creativity to unlock the full potential of this one-of-a-kind Skyline property and create something truly special in one of Portland's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Tucked into a large, private .27-acre lot, this updated daylight ranch offers the kind of space, character and flexibility that is hard to find in SW Portland. With 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and over 2,350 square feet, the home has a comfortable, open feel with great natural light and plenty of room to spread out.The main level features a refreshed kitchen with refinished full-length butcher block countertops, updated cabinet fronts and a layout that opens nicely into the surrounding living spaces. The primary bedroom is located on the main level, while the daylight lower level adds flexible space for a family room, home office, guests or media room along with a fully refinished bathroom.Outside, the property really stands out. Mature landscaping creates a private setting with a beautiful deck, refreshed garden beds, new stone pathways and plenty of room to entertain, garden or simply enjoy the yard.The home has a newer roof, updated electrical, new main-level flooring, fresh paint throughout, upgraded insulation, newer sewer main, improved drainage, newer A/C and furnace, updated fencing and more. Major improvements already completed on a spacious lot in a great SW Portland location.

Welcome home to this stunning mid-century gem, seamlessly blending classic architectural character with modern luxury! Boasting a bright and airy living space, this 4 bedroom 2.5 bath home on an oversized lot features an open floor plan designed for effortless everyday living and vibrant entertaining!At the heart of the home is the beautiful kitchen with granite countertops and large island which flows naturally into the main living space. Large windows flood the interior with beautiful natural light, perfectly highlighting the wide-open layout! Beautiful wood floors throughout, 2 fireplaces,and vaulted ceilings!Step outside into your own private resort! The backyard features a fantastic sparkling 20x40 in-ground pool-perfect for hot summer days, weekend barbeques, and poolside lounging. Your paradise awaits you! A rare find in a superb location!

Tremendous Opportunity! Open House Sat 11/14 12-2pm! Charachter, charm, 1920's home with generous floor plan all in Cedar Hills! Set back from the road in a soft setting w/an inviting front porch, the classic stucco w/brick trim creates a feeling of nostalgia & of homes of bygone eras. They just don’t make them like this anymore. Inside, sunlight pours through the large windows while tall ceilings continue the spacious flow. A floor-to-ceiling brick fireplace w/gas insert takes center stage, wrapping the room in the unmistakable warmth & comfort that says “home.” The dining room flows into the generous kitchen w/ss appliances, tile island + a farmhouse sink. The main level also features a well-sized bedroom & separate bathroom, convenient for overnight guests or for office space. Also of note, enjoy the large living spaces, tall ceilings, exposed beams, oak hardwood floors & built-in bookshelves. Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom has vaulted ceilings, skylights & dual closets for fantastic storage. Two additional light-filled bedrooms complete the upper level along w/the hall bathroom. The unfinished basement w/tall ceilings provides over 1300 sqft of exceptional flexibility & enormous potential to build out (Multi gen use? Gym? Theater?) Outside, the fully fenced backyard is a great space for curating your garden or for play. This convenient location puts your favorite shops, restaurants, parks, healthcare + the tech corridor nearby. Recent updates show pride of ownership: 2026: New Hot Water Heater 2024: Kitchen Storage System 2023: SS Refrigerator 2022: Upgraded Basement Plumbing, New Backyard Fencing on two sides, New Sewer Line, Electrical Upgrades in Basement & Garage 2021: New Gas Fireplace & Renovated Stairway. Request the list of updates & amenities! If you have been dreaming of a home with soul and room for putting down roots, welcome home!

Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, this charming Cape Cod/Colonial-style home offers a beautiful, tree-lined setting, timeless character, and incredible flexibility! The spacious daylight basement features a separate ADU with a bedroom, walk-in closet, kitchen, living room with fireplace, and laundry. Currently rented for $1,836/month, the ADU provides an income opportunity, with the option to eventually incorporate the space into the main home. The property currently lives as a 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home with a separate ADU, but could be converted into a 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home.Inside, enjoy hardwood floors, custom built-ins, abundant natural light, three gas fireplaces, updated dual-pane wood windows, a dedicated dining room, den, A/C, and a generator. The remodeled kitchen features granite countertops, tile backsplash, vintage-style range and hood, under-cabinet lighting, ample storage, and a cozy dining area with fireplace. French doors open to a spacious deck overlooking the beautifully established yard, complete with an apple tree, hydrangeas, and colorful seasonal landscaping.The generous primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, hardwood floors, a walk-in closet, and a beautifully remodeled bathroom with dual sinks, granite countertops, and an oversized walk-in shower with bench.Conveniently located near parks and trails, just 5 minutes from Multnomah Village and approximately 10 minutes from downtown Portland, OHSU, and the waterfront, with easy freeway access. A unique opportunity offering classic charm, flexible living spaces, and rental income potential!

Substantial Price Reduction-- At the crest of Vermont Hills a marvelous, well cared for, one level Mid-Century Modern. Tasteful updates to kitchen & baths lead the list of improvements over the last 10 years, which include roof, newly rebuilt chimney, freshly resealed box gutters, new downspouts, new gas fireplace insert, furnace & a/c, newly upgraded electrical, replaced driveway, newly insulated floors, & new vapor barrier in the crawl space. Freshly painted interior walls await while the fenced outdoor space is quite private with fresh exterior paint & a custom designed, biome supportive, entry garden, with added raised bed kitchen and cutting garden. Find enhanced hardscapes, including new patios, walks, new artisan fencing & lighting. Deep eaves offer extended season use, shedding heat & rain alike. Inside, classic Mid-Century detailing is preserved with period built-ins, floor treatments, doors & mill work, as well as a stone living room fireplace with raised hearth & slab granite bench. An archetypal side entrance features a variegated flat stone foyer. The kitchen has granite counters, plenitudinous cabinet space, all stainless appliances including double wall oven, 5 burner gas cooktop, hood, Bosch D/W & French door refrigerator. The roomy dining area adjacent the kitchen will accommodate a substantial table & is graced with an iconic, multi-part, Nelson pendant chandelier, an epitome of MCM decorative design. The primary bedroom offers broad double closets, an efficient dressing area & en-suite custom tiled bath. A separate family room and home office area finish the home. Across the street enjoy the grounds of the water storage station, which functions like a private local park & features tremendous westerly sunset & Tualatin Valley views, complete with resident Great Horned Owl. Other area attractions include Gabriel Park, food carts, southwest trail system, Multnomah Village. This home has much to offer in unmistakable Mid-Century style. Don't Hesitate!

New market position - exceptional value in Southwest Burlingame minutes from Downtown Portland, Multnomah Village, and Hillsdale. Beautifully-maintained 3,484 sf residence offers multiple flexible gathering and work-from-home spaces, and four direct connections to private outdoor living. Major improvements include a 2018 roof, sprawling 2021 Trex deck, two independent 2021 Daikin HVAC systems, 2022 ILVE range and recently refreshed bathrooms. Surrounded by natural beauty and filled with abundant light and known as “Maison Capella,” it provides a sense of calm while remaining conveniently close a diversity of neighborhood hubs. The seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living enhances the home’s appeal, creating spaces to relax and recharge. With a refined yet welcoming character, this residence presents an exceptional opportunity to enjoy a lifestyle defined by tranquility, and enduring quality. A home perfectly pitched like a tuning fork of gracious proportion, it lives up to its reputation of hosting large scale events while also scaling as a cozy retreat that is intuitive and cohesive. Nestled in a peaceful setting, it offers a rare balance of privacy, comfort, and connection. As broker for additional folio information.

Significant price recuction on this beautifully updated Johns Landing Home! This home has been updated throughout including new roof, hardwood floors, gas fireplace, gourmet kitchen, spa like primary suite, HVAC, tankless water heater, central vac, and so much more! Living room has a floor to ceiling gas fireplace, adjacent dining & kitchen complete with granite, tile, peninsula, and stainless appliances. The upper level boasts 2 bedrooms, a spa like primary suite with hardwood floors, a sitting area, a walk-in closet, and private balcony. The attached bath suite has tile, granite, steam shower, heated floors & towel bar. Lower level has large family room, full bathroom, utility room & wine storage. The backyard is an oasis with palms, bamboo, stone pavers, stamped concrete, fire pit, planters, water feature, and lighting. The detached extra deep garage with above ADU was permitted & built in 2017 with long term Airbnb history earning $25,000 annually. All ADU items and included in the purchase. The garage has EV outlet and can accommodate a boat as well as vehicle parking. The entire property is fenced, gated and professionally landscaped with lighting. This oasis in the city has an unheard of 9-energy score! Located in walkable Johns Landing, with shopping, restaurants, and recreational opportunities at nearby Willamette Park with access to Portland’s 10-mile waterfront bike path connecting to the many bikes paths & neighborhood walking trails PDX is so famous for! This property is 10 minutes from the city center, with access to transportation including streetcar, tram, Max, bus and freeways. This updated, energy-efficient property with ADU income, represents strong value for money!

Renovated mid century modern in the heart of Hillsdale, perfectly positioned on a quiet, centrally located street. This daylight ranch offers 4 bedrooms — including two primary suites (one on the main) — 3 full baths, and a rare 2 car garage with urethane coated system floors ideal for a home gym or workshop. The open concept great room showcases iconic mid century warmth with birch panel ceilings, engineered glulam and steel beams, and dramatic glass bi fold doors that expand the living space onto a newly added $60K expansive deck with sunset views. The outdoor experience is elevated even further with a custom high temperature brick pizza oven, perfect for gatherings and year round entertaining. Inside, thoughtful upgrades blend seamlessly with the home’s architectural roots. The lower level primary suite recently had a $120K upgrade features a wood burning fireplace, walk in closet, and renovated bath, creating a private retreat with timeless character. With its signature indoor–outdoor flow, rare garage setup, and curated mid century details, this Hillsdale home delivers a standout blend of design, comfort, and location!

Prepare to fall in love. Perched above the neighborhood on a private lot bordering the beautiful Amaterra Winery vineyards, this Scandinavian modern farmhouse pairs striking design with sweeping southwest views and unforgettable sunsets. Thoughtfully renovated with European-inspired finishes, this distinctive home offers light-filled living, exceptional outdoor spaces and your very own attached indoor pool.Soaring ceilings and walls of south-facing windows create an airy backdrop for everyday living and entertaining. The open kitchen, dining and living spaces flow seamlessly, while glass doors extend the spacious main-floor great room onto a mahogany deck overlooking the valley. The beautifully updated kitchen features natural slate flooring, quartz countertops, a gas range, Viking refrigerator and a welcoming eating nook.Upstairs, the dedicated primary suite is a peaceful retreat with a spa-like bathroom, generous walk-in closet and private view balcony. A second bedroom offers custom built-in shelving and its own deck, while the third includes an approximately 400-square-foot finished upper bonus space with skylights—ideal for a studio, study or creative escape. A fourth bedroom, full bathroom and spacious laundry room complete the upper level.The attached indoor pool brings a little vacation home, offering year-round enjoyment beneath soaring vaulted ceilings. Glass French doors open to the outdoors, creating a bright, inviting setting for a morning swim or a relaxing afternoon.Extensive updates include wood and slate tile flooring, siding, roofing, paint, lighting and decks with modern railings. An oversized two-car garage and generous driveway provide ample parking. Private and beautifully positioned, yet just minutes from Amaterra, St. Vincent Hospital, Nike, Intel, Catlin Gabel and downtown Portland, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy modern living in an extraordinary setting.

Timeless elegance and exceptional livability come together in this impressive 6-bedroom, 4.5-bath NW Portland residence. A grand entrance welcomes you into a spacious floor plan filled with natural light, expansive windows, and rich architectural details. Designed for both entertaining and everyday comfort, the home features four fireplaces and custom built-ins throughout the house. At the heart of the home, the chef’s kitchen showcases a generous cook island, illuminated cabinetry, and double ovens. The adjoining breakfast nook is framed by wraparound windows and opens to the deck, creating an idyllic spot for morning coffee or effortless indoor-outdoor gatherings. The primary suite is a true sanctuary. The spa-inspired ensuite features a double-sided fireplace, luxurious soaking tub, walk-in shower, and an oversized walk-in closet—creating a private retreat at the end of the day. The lower level expands the possibilities with a large bonus/flex space, additional bedroom, and utility room with abundant storage. Whether envisioned as a media room, guest retreat, home gym, or recreation space, the flexible layout adapts beautifully to a variety of lifestyles. Outside, discover a peaceful wooded setting designed for relaxation. A lower-level deck with hot tub invites you to unwind among the trees, while the adjacent grassy area offers space for play, gardening, entertaining, or simply enjoying the serene surroundings. A rare combination of scale, character, natural light, luxurious amenities, and tranquil outdoor living—this exceptional NW Portland home is ready to be enjoyed.

Welcome to this meticulously well maintained home, located on a dead end street and convenient location in Bethany. This custom built home features an office and full bathroom on the main floor, open space living/dining room with large windows, three bedrooms and a functional loft on the second floor. You will be stress free with the low maintenance turf yard and the low HOA. Step into a warm and welcoming culinary hub that perfectly balances timeless elegance with everyday comfort. The beautiful kitchen is equipped with stainless appliances, gas stove and ventilation hood. The white quartz counters, white cabinets and grey backlash match perfectly that brighten the entire room. The primary bedroom features a walk- in closet, double sinks and walk-in shower. The loft could be used as the entertainment area, study or gym. High ceiling and large windows offer the comfort living. Tankless water heater and energy efficient furnace. Bethany village is just a few minutes away. Jacob/Stoller/Sunset.

Shorewood plan featuring an open-concept great room that's perfect for everyday living and entertaining. The main level includes a convenient bedroom and full bathroom, ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a home office. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite, plus a versatile loft that can be used as a media room, play area, or home workspace. Located in the heart of North Bethany, one of Portland's most sought-after family-friendly communities, this home offers exceptional access to parks, walking trails, and outdoor recreation. Enjoy nearby Bethany Lake, Pirate Park, Rock Creek Trail, and local farms with seasonal berry picking and pumpkin patches. Take a short stroll to Bethany Village Centre for shopping, dining, and community events, including summer concerts and holiday markets. Family favorites like Piccolo Mondo Toy Store and Play Street Museum are just minutes away, while Forest Park, the Oregon Zoo, and many of Portland's top attractions are within easy driving distance. A 3D tour of the same floor plan is available. Schedule your private appointment today to experience the home in person. Designer apointed features selected.

Opportunity awaits in this spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home with great bones and endless potential! Featuring soaring vaulted ceilings and a versatile floor plan, this home offers a dedicated office/bedroom on the main level—perfect for guest space, working from home or creating a quiet study space. The large open kitchen provides abundant storage and ample room for gathering, entertaining, and everyday living. Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms upstairs and plenty of natural light throughout. The current downstairs half bath offers flexibility and could potentially be converted back to a full bathroom, or the space could be finished and incorporated into an expanded laundry room to better suit your needs. Step outside to enjoy a beautiful garden setting and a charming backyard retreat, creating the perfect place to relax, unwind, or entertain guests. The private outdoor space offers a peaceful escape with room to enjoy nature right at home. While the home would benefit from new flooring, it presents an excellent opportunity for buyers to add their own style and build equity in a desirable setting. With generous living spaces, abundant storage, and a wonderful backyard oasis, this property is ready for its next chapter.

Seller will contribute to buyer closing costs or prepaids. Designed for effortless entertaining and daily life, welcome to 12931 NW Kyla Lane. The main level flows naturally into an expansive great room and an island kitchen equipped with a butler’s pantry and gas appliances. Entertain in style with a dedicated media room outfitted with an Optoma laser projector, 7.1 Onkyo sound system, and a 145" screen. If it's open-air you seek, your huge covered deck, patio, and terraced garden extend the living space outdoors for year-round gatherings. Upstairs, a flexible five-bedroom layout provides abundant space, highlighted by a primary suite featuring a soaking tub and walk-in closet. This highly sought-after Bethany location keeps you connected to the metro, yet has a relaxed, unhurried feel. You'll enjoy proximity to Forest Park trails, convenient shopping, and a streamlined commute via Highway 26. With a three-car garage, new roof (2023) and fresh interior paint, your new home is turn key and ready to be part of your next chapter. Your new home comes complete with: drip irrigation front and back yards, electric car charger, Wyze security and washer and dryer. Seller will consider a contribution toward Buyer’s rate buydown or closing costs.

listings.address: 3964 NW FALL CREEK PL Portland, OR 97229
listings.remarks: Welcome to Claremont, a sought-after 55+ active community in Bethany! Owned by the original, single resident since it was built, this single-level home sits on a sunny lot along a quiet closed-end street. The open great room features soaring ceilings, a cozy gas fireplace, and large windows that welcome plenty of natural light. Hardwood floors extend through the spacious kitchen which offers a central island, pantry, and generous workspace. A separate laundry room provides convenient access to the two-car garage. The primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with an oversized walk-in closet, soaking tub, and walk-in shower. With three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, the home offers a comfortable and functional layout. Outside, enjoy a beautifully landscaped yard and a private, fenced backyard complete with a patio. Claremont residents enjoy an exceptional range of amenities, including two clubhouses, two pools, a nine-hole golf course, putting course, tennis and pickleball courts, a fitness room, and a variety of clubs and social activities. Enjoy easy single-level living in a welcoming community with plenty of opportunities to stay active and connected.

Some homes simply give you more room to live well. In sought-after Bauer Oaks, this beautifully updated Cedar Mill home pairs generous living spaces with the flexibility today's buyers are looking for. A dedicated office makes working from home easy, while the oversized bonus room can evolve right along with you into a movie room, game room, gym, creative space or the ultimate hangout. The updates are already done, with quartz countertops, high-end appliances, updated lighting, newer carpet and paint creating a fresh, polished interior. Even better, a newer roof, furnace and air conditioning take several major homeownership expenses off the list. Outside, a low-maintenance backyard offers an inviting place to relax and entertain without demanding your weekends. All of this in established Bauer Oaks, close to highly regarded Beaverton schools and with convenient access to Nike, Intel, the Sunset Corridor and downtown Portland. Plenty of space, remarkably little to do, and a home that's ready to be enjoyed from day one.

Luxury meets nature in this nearly new McCormick Craftsman, completed in late 2022 and ideally positioned on one of the community's most desirable homesites. Backing to protected green space on both the rear and side of the property, this exceptional setting offers a rare sense of privacy, peaceful forest views, and the feeling of having no immediate neighbors beyond your own backyard. The covered outdoor living area and expansive great room are perfectly oriented to capture the tranquil surroundings through walls of glass, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle.Inside, a dramatic two-story entry, soaring 10-foot ceilings, and impeccable craftsmanship set the tone for this beautifully upgraded home. The gourmet chef's kitchen is appointed with premium appliances and designer finishes, while the expanded primary suite features dual walk-in closets and a luxurious spa-inspired bath. A main-level office/den or a 6th bedroom and a versatile finished lower level provide ideal accommodations for guests and multigenerational living. Built with today's most desirable amenities, including zoned HVAC, a tankless water heater, this residence combines modern luxury with exceptional livability. Just minutes from top-rated schools, parks, trails, and Bethany Village, this is a rare opportunity to own a better-than-new home in an unmatched natural setting.

PRICE REDUCED. SELLER MOTIVATED TO SELL. Location, Location, Location. Welcome to this charming ranch-style home! Newly remodeled and offering a comfortable single-level layout, the seller is willing to carry back the loan for 5 years with 20% down & 4.99% interest rate. This light, bright home features 1610 sq ft, 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, a family room, and a 2-car garage. The large family room offers plenty of space to relax, gather, and entertain, making it an ideal choice for everyday living. Features: updated kitchen, Wood fireplace, hardwood floors, new A/C and furnace, patio, shed, and fenced yard.

Still time to choose your design package! The spacious Holly plan at Elevon with soaring 10-foot ceilings on the main level and 9-foot ceilings upstairs, creating a bright, open layout filled with natural light. The kitchen is designed for gathering, featuring quartz countertops, a spacious island, a dedicated pantry for extra storage, gas cooktop with designer hood, and wall oven with microwave. It flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas, making everyday living and entertaining easy. Upstairs offers flexible space for guests, work-from-home, or hobbies. Enjoy a private fenced yard for relaxing outdoors, pets, or summer evenings. Located in Elevon, a vibrant new Beaverton community planned around a future retail promenade with coffee shops, restaurants and neighborhood gathering spaces, with convenient access to major employers and everyday amenities. Builder interest rate incentive opportunities available — reach out for details! Photos are of similar Model home. Taxes/HOA estimated.

Rare opportunity on a large 0.48-acre lot with valuable RMC zoning and extensive recent updates. This remodeled 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features a new roof, updated kitchen with new cabinets and countertops, new water heater, updated bath cabinetry, added half bath, two new mini-split systems, new electrical panel, new doors, replaced rear siding, and fresh interior and exterior paint. Move in and enjoy today while exploring future possibilities. According to City information, the property may have potential for partitioning and additional residential development, including homes, townhomes, duplexes, triplexes, and more. Ideal for owner-occupants, builders, and investors seeking flexibility and long-term value. Buyer to perform all due diligence regarding zoning, development potential, partitioning, and intended use.

Stunningly remodeled 3 bedrooms 2.1 bath home in desirable Highland Hills on a large corner lot! Head to toe remodel with new floors, windows, HVAC, water heater, interior/exterior paint, fixtures, appliances and more. Spacious open floorplan and kitchen with eat up bar perfect for entertaining! Primary suite features a walk in closet, double sinks and beautiful walk-in shower. New sliding doors open to covered patio in fully fenced yard! Just 2 houses down from Fir Grove park with playground, picnic tables and paved walking trails through the forest! Welcome home!

Welcome to this beautifully appointed Craftsman-style home in the desirable Miller Point neighborhood! Offering 2,730 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home combines comfort, functionality, and timeless appeal. The inviting great room features hardwood floors and a cozy gas fireplace, creating the perfect gathering space. The kitchen is well-appointed with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, gas cooking, a spacious island, and pantry storage. A versatile main-level bedroom or home office adds flexibility, while the upper level offers generously sized bedrooms and a spacious bonus room. The primary suite provides a relaxing retreat with a soaking tub and separate shower. Enjoy outdoor living with a covered deck, patio, and fenced backyard.
